entities.label: Text
entities.summary: 1938 japanese law which put civilian organizations (incl. labor unions) under governmental control, nationalized some industries (e.g. the media), introduced price controls and rationing and provided for unlimited budget to subsidize war production Created c. 1938. National Mobilization Law is a statute, created circa 1938-03-24. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
